summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses the historical evolution of Syrian wedding customs, contrasting modern practices with those documented in the book Ohel Yesharim by Hacham Abraham Antebi. He details the specific roles of the Hazzan and the Rabbi during the ceremony, as well as the traditional kinyan performed under the chuppah.
questions: Who was Hacham Abraham Antebi and what did he write about weddings?
What was the traditional role of the Hazzan at a wedding?
How were the berachot divided between Rabbis in the past?
What is the history of the kinyan performed with a handkerchief?
Did the custom of having bridesmaids and groomsmen always exist?
